name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
summary: In Gadgetzan, Dirge Quikcleave has his recipe ready, but the meat needs attention soon. He asks you for twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt before it spoils.

sections.title: What Dirge Still Needs
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave handles the spices himself, while the meat you brought him makes up the rest of the dish. He still needs twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt. With both in hand, the chicken can go back to Narain Soothfancy. Dirge urges you to hurry before the meat goes bad.

aliases: who gives dirge's kickin chimaerok chops
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan asks you for the supplies to finish his recipe.

faq.q: What ingredients does Dirge Quikcleave need?
faq.answer: Dirge needs twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt. He handles the spices, and the meat you brought him covers the rest.

faq.q: Who is the finished dish intended for?
faq.answer: Dirge says the finished bird is ready to be carried back to Narain Soothfancy.

faq.q: What comes after delivering these ingredients?
aliases: what do i do after dirge chops
faq.answer: After you deliver the ingredients, return to Narain Soothfancy.
